applyPenalty(uint256).notice: Applies a penalty via increase debt (only callable from rocketMegapoolPenalties)

assignFunds(uint32).notice: Accepts requested funds from the deposit pool

calculatePendingRewards().notice: Returns the calculated split of pending rewards

calculateRewards(uint256).notice: Calculates the split of rewards for a given amount of ETH

challengeExit(uint32).notice: Used to optimistically lock a megapool with an oDAO challenging that a validator has exited

claim().notice: Claims any distributed but unclaimed rewards

deprecate().notice: Called by an upgrade to begin the expiry countdown for this delegate

dequeue(uint32).notice: Removes a validator from the deposit queue

dissolveValidator(uint32).notice: Dissolves a validator that has not staked within the required period

forceExit(uint32).notice: Force exits a validator when instructed by the network exit contract

getActiveValidatorCount().notice: Returns the number of validators that are considered for bond requirement

getAssignedValue().notice: Returns the amount of ETH temporarily held in this contract from the protocol ready to be staked

getDebt().notice: Returns the amount of ETH the node operator owes the protocol

getExitingValidatorCount().notice: Returns the number of validators currently exiting

getExpirationTime().notice: Returns the time at which this delegate expires (or 0 if not yet deprecated)

getLastDistributionTime().notice: Returns the block timestamp of the last distribution performed

getLockedValidatorCount().notice: Returns the number of validators locked by a exit challenge

getNewValidatorBondRequirement().notice: Returns the bond requirement for a new validator

getNodeAddress().notice: Gets the Node address associated to this megapool

getNodeBond().notice: Returns the amount of ETH supplied by the node operator (Bonded ETH)

getNodeQueuedBond().notice: Returns the amount of ETH bond provided by the node operator waiting in the queue for assignment

getPendingRewards().notice: Returns the amount in wei of pending rewards ready to be distributed

getRefundValue().notice: Returns the amount of ETH available to refund to the node operator

getUserCapital().notice: Returns the amount of ETH capital provided by the protocol (Borrowed ETH)

getUserQueuedCapital().notice: Returns the amount of ETH capital provided by the protocol waiting in the queue for assignment

getValidatorCount().notice: Returns the number of validators created for this megapool

getValidatorInfo(uint32).notice: Returns information about a given validator

getValidatorInfoAndPubkey(uint32).notice: Returns both validator information and pubkey

getValidatorPubkey(uint32).notice: Returns pubkey for a given validator

getWithdrawalCredentials().notice: Returns the expected withdrawal credentials for any validator within this megapool

newValidator(uint256,bool,bytes,bytes,by.notice: Creates a new validator for this megapool

notifyExit(uint32,uint64,uint64).notice: Used to notify the megapool that one of its validators is exiting the beaconchain

notifyFinalBalance(uint32,uint64,address.notice: Used to notify the megapool of the final balance of an exited validator

reduceBond(uint256).notice: Reduces this megapool's bond and applies credit if current bond exceeds requirement

repayDebt().notice: Receives ETH, which is sent to the rETH contract, to repay a debt owed by the node operator

retryExit(uint32).notice: Resubmits an EL exit without changing the existing exit state or accounting

stake(uint32).notice: Performs the remaining ETH deposit on the Beacon Chain
